title: Module 21 — CPU & Memory Performance
description: Install the performance toolkit, read an idle machine with the USE method, generate a CPU load and measure it with mpstat, and FEEL the cache with a row-major vs column-major timing. All work is scoped to a throwaway ~/perf-lab and the machine is restored at the end.

steps.title: Install the toolkit and read the spec sheet
Generate a CPU load and measure it
Feel the cache: row-major vs column-major
